boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost activities and places in San Marcos for CSUSM students.

cards.title: Explore Jack's Pond Nature Center
cards.subtitle: Jack's Pond Park, San Marcos
cards.notes: Go Sunday morning to browse the hands-on nature rooms, then continue outside to the pond, gardens, and trails.
cards.short_summary: A public nature center with interactive exhibits and outdoor trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Jack's Pond Nature Center as open to the public Sundays from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. with free admission.
cards.source_title: Jack's Pond Nature Center | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Public Sundays, 10 a.m.–1 p.m.; volunteer availability can cause closures.

cards.entity_name: Community Rock Snake at Jack's Pond
cards.title: Add a Painted Rock to the Community Rock Snake
cards.subtitle: Jack's Pond Nature Center, San Marcos
cards.notes: Paint a rock you have at home and add it to the community display; leave existing rocks in place for others to see.
cards.short_summary: A free, participatory outdoor art display at Jack's Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: The City invites community members to find and paint a rock, then add it to the free interactive Community Rock Snake display.
cards.source_title: Jack's Pond Nature Center | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Bring your own painted rock; the City asks visitors only to add rocks, not remove them.

cards.title: Join the Discovery Hills City Hike
cards.subtitle: City Hikes program; Lakeview Park meeting point
cards.notes: Use the City Hikes listing to confirm the next date, then meet at Lakeview Park for the ranger-led Discovery Hills route.
cards.short_summary: A ranger-led 5.3-mile figure-eight hike through Discovery Hills.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes its ranger-led City Hikes as free and identifies the Discovery Hills Hike as a 5.3-mile route meeting at Lakeview Park.
cards.source_title: Upcoming Hikes | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current hike calendar and route conditions with the City before going.

cards.title: Walk the Heart of The City Route
cards.subtitle: City Hikes program; San Marcos Community Center meeting point
cards.notes: Check the next City Hikes date and join the guided loop from the Community Center through Civic Center and Hollandia Park.
cards.short_summary: A guided urban-and-park loop through central San Marcos.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists City Hikes as free and describes Heart of The City as a 6.5-mile loop beginning at the San Marcos Community Center.
cards.source_title: Upcoming Hikes | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current hike calendar and route conditions with the City before going.

cards.entity_name: Twilight Trek: A Hike Under the Stars
cards.title: Sign Up for the Twilight Trek
cards.subtitle: City Hikes program; Double Peak Park meeting point
cards.notes: Check the posted date, bring a light and water, and follow the ranger on the official Cerro de Las Posas ridgeline route.
cards.short_summary: A ranger-led evening hike using the Cerro de Las Posas ridgeline trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calls its ranger-led City Hikes free and lists Twilight Trek as a guided hike starting at Double Peak Park.
cards.source_title: Upcoming Hikes | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current hike calendar, difficulty, and daylight requirements with the City before going.

cards.entity_name: Trails Day Ranger-Led Hike to Double Peak Park
cards.title: Hike to Double Peak on Trails Day
cards.subtitle: San Marcos Trails Day; Lakeview Park
cards.notes: Watch the City's event calendar for the next Trails Day, then choose the ranger-led five-mile hike from Lakeview Park.
cards.short_summary: A free annual event option featuring a five-mile guided hike to Double Peak.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes Trails Day as a free event and lists a ranger-led five-mile hike to Double Peak Park among its activities.
cards.source_title: Discover the great outdoors with San Marcos at Trails Day | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: This is an annual event; verify the next date, check-in details, and route conditions with the City.

cards.entity_name: Trails Day Discovery Trails and South Lake Bike Ride
cards.title: Ride Discovery Trails and South Lake on Trails Day
cards.subtitle: San Marcos Trails Day; Lakeview Park
cards.notes: Bring a maintained bike and confirm the next Trails Day schedule for the five-mile guided Discovery Trails and South Lake loop.
cards.short_summary: A free guided five-mile bike-ride option during Trails Day.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Trails Day as free and lists a five-mile bike ride through Discovery Trails and South Lake.
cards.source_title: Discover the great outdoors with San Marcos at Trails Day | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: This is an annual event; verify the next date and bring equipment required for safe cycling.

cards.entity_name: Trails Day Discovery Lake Interpretive Walk
cards.title: Take the Discovery Lake Interpretive Walk
cards.subtitle: San Marcos Trails Day; Lakeview Park
cards.notes: Choose the one-mile interpretive walk when Trails Day returns, and stay on the official trail around Discovery Lake.
cards.short_summary: A free, ranger-led one-mile walk around Discovery Lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes Trails Day as free and lists a one-mile interpretive walk around Discovery Lake.
cards.source_title: Discover the great outdoors with San Marcos at Trails Day | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: This is an annual event; verify the next date and follow posted lake and trail rules.

cards.entity_name: Free Movies in the Park at Hollandia Park
cards.title: Bring a Blanket for Movies in the Park
cards.subtitle: Hollandia Park, San Marcos
cards.notes: Check the City's summer schedule, bring a blanket or lawn chair, and arrive for the pre-show activities before sunset.
cards.short_summary: A recurring family-friendly outdoor-movie series in San Marcos parks.
cards.evidence_claim: The City states that Movies in the Park events are free and lists Hollandia Park as a 2026 series location.
cards.source_title: Movies in the Park series returns this summer | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Seasonal series; consult the City's current calendar for film, date, weather updates, and parking guidance.

cards.entity_name: Free Movies in the Park at Las Posas Park
cards.title: Catch a Free Movie at Las Posas Park
cards.subtitle: Las Posas Park, San Marcos
cards.notes: Use the City schedule to confirm the next showing, then bring your own blanket or chair for the outdoor screening.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission outdoor movie night at Las Posas Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calls the Movies in the Park series free and lists Las Posas Park as a 2026 location.
cards.source_title: Movies in the Park series returns this summer | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: Seasonal series; consult the City's current calendar for film, date, weather updates, and parking guidance.
